panels.title: HTTP errors per second by route

targets.expr: sum by (route, status_class) (rate(trip_api_http_request_duration_seconds_count{status_class=~"4xx|5xx"}[5m]) and on (job, instance) ((up{job="trip-api"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{job="trip-api"}) < 90)))

panels.title: P95 time to response headers by route

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (rate(trip_api_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) and on (job, instance) ((up{job="trip-api"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{job="trip-api"}) < 90))))
